On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
translations.bsb: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
translations.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
translations.asv: And when he knew that he was of Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him unto Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem in these days.
